content.text: A Deep Dive on Coachella Ticket PricesCoachella 2026 secondary market prices split into two sharply different tiers depending on how you buy. A 3-day pass for either weekend averages $1,330–$1,331 with a get-in of $945–$953 — nearly identical across Weekend 1 and Weekend 2. Single-day tickets tell a different story: Friday admission averages $4,691–$4,698, Saturday and Sunday average $3,481 each, with a floor of $1,152. The most expensive single day — Friday — costs more per ticket than the entire three-day pass. That pricing inversion is the defining feature of Coachella's secondary market in 2026, and it has a direct impact on how buyers should approach the purchase decision. The math on single-day versus multi-day is stark. A 3-day pass at $1,330 average works out to roughly $443 per day. A single Friday ticket at $4,691 average is 10x that figure. Even Saturday and Sunday at $3,481 each are nearly eight times the per-day cost of the pass. This is not a marginal difference — it reflects a structural market dynamic where single-day supply is thin and demand is concentrated, while 3-day passes represent the efficient way the secondary market clears for buyers who planned ahead. For anyone entering the market now, the 3-day pass is the highest-value ticket format on the secondary market by a significant margin. The Weekend 1 versus Weekend 2 pricing gap, which most buyers assume exists, effectively does not. Weekend 1 (April 10–12) averages $1,330 with a $945 get-in; Weekend 2 (April 17–19) averages $1,331 with a $953 get-in — an $8 difference in average price and a $1 difference in average. Gametime's secondary market data does not show a meaningful first-weekend premium for 2026. The same headliners — Sabrina Carpenter, Justin Bieber, Karol G — perform both weekends, and buyer behavior has priced the two identically. For anyone flexible on dates, Weekend 2 offers no discount but also no premium for the same experience. Friday's pricing premium over Saturday and Sunday reflects a combination of factors that consistently push opening-night prices above the rest of the festival. First-night scarcity concentrates demand: buyers who can only attend one day disproportionately choose Friday to maximize their weekend. The headliner set time placement for Friday night also carries outsized weight on secondary markets. The result is a $1,210 average gap between Friday ($4,691) and Saturday/Sunday ($3,481) — a 35% premium for a single night's additional attendance. The data suggests buyers treating Friday as a standalone purchase are paying a scarcity premium that the 3-day pass absorbs across all three days. The shuttle pass is the only sub-$1,000 entry point in Gametime's Coachella inventory, with a $277 get-in for Weekend 2 transportation — a practical add-on for pass holders, not a festival admission alternative. Outside of that, the secondary market floor for festival entry is $945. At the top end, $4,698 average for a single Friday ticket places Coachella among the most expensive single-day ticketed events tracked in the live entertainment market, exceeding average Super Bowl and NBA Finals secondary prices. This analysis reflects secondary market data tracked by Gametime for the 2026 Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival.How much are Coachella 2026 tickets?Coachella 2026 secondary market prices range from $945 get-in for a 3-day pass to over $4,698 average for a single Friday ticket. The most accessible entry point for full festival access is the 3-day pass, which averages $1,330–$1,331 for both weekends with get-in prices of $945–$953. Single-day tickets are significantly more expensive: Fridays average $4,691–$4,698, while Saturdays and Sundays average $3,481 each with a $1,152 floor. A Weekend 2 shuttle pass is available from $277, but covers transportation only — not festival admission.Is it cheaper to buy a 3-day pass or single-day Coachella tickets?Three-day passes are dramatically cheaper on a per-day basis. A 3-day pass averaging $1,330 works out to roughly $443 per day. A single Friday ticket averages $4,691 — more than 10 times the per-day cost of the pass. Saturday and Sunday single-day tickets average $3,481 each, nearly eight times the per-day pass rate. If you plan to attend more than one day, the 3-day pass is the highest-value format on the secondary market by a wide margin. Single-day tickets carry a structural scarcity premium that is not present in the 3-day pass market.Are Coachella Weekend 1 and Weekend 2 tickets the same price?Yes, effectively identical. Gametime's secondary market data shows Weekend 1 (April 10–12) averaging $1,330 with a $945 get-in, and Weekend 2 (April 17–19) averaging $1,331 with a $953 get-in — a $1 difference in average price. The common assumption that Weekend 1 carries a meaningful premium does not hold in 2026 pricing data. Both weekends feature the same headliners (Sabrina Carpenter, Justin Bieber, Karol G) performing the same sets, and buyer demand has priced them accordingly. There is no data-supported reason to pay more for a specific weekend.What is the most expensive day at Coachella?Friday is by far the most expensive single day at Coachella 2026. Friday tickets average $4,691–$4,698, compared to $3,481 for both Saturday and Sunday — a 35% premium, or roughly $1,210 more per ticket. The Friday premium reflects opening-night scarcity dynamics: buyers who can attend only one day disproportionately target Friday, concentrating demand on the thinnest single-day inventory. The gap is consistent across both weekends. If cost is a primary consideration, Saturday or Sunday single-day tickets offer the same festival access at materially lower prices.What is the cheapest way to get into Coachella?The lowest-cost path to attending is a 3-day pass, with get-in prices starting at $945 for either weekend. Despite the higher face-value appearance, the 3-day pass is significantly cheaper per day than any single-day ticket option. Weekend 1 and Weekend 2 are priced virtually identically, so date flexibility does not produce savings. A Weekend 2 shuttle pass is available from $277 but covers transportation to and from the venue only — festival admission is a separate purchase. There is no under-$945 route to full Coachella access on the current secondary market.Should I buy Coachella 2026 tickets now or wait?Buy now. Coachella is a fixed-capacity, fixed-date event with no additional inventory coming to market, and 2026 headliner demand — Sabrina Carpenter, Justin Bieber, Karol G — is high across both weekends. Gametime's secondary market data shows 3-day pass prices holding at $1,330, with no historical pattern of meaningful relief in the final weeks before the festival. Single-day Friday tickets, already at $4,691–$4,698 average, tend to increase as the event approaches because last-minute buyers compete for the thinnest inventory category. The risk of waiting is price appreciation with no offsetting discount scenario. For buyers who are committed to attending, earlier purchase locks in current pricing — the downside of waiting is asymmetric. Content notes: All price figures reflect Gametime secondary market data for Coachella 2026 as of current tracking. Prices are dynamic and subject to change as event dates approach.
